name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Your framing of the Channel Partner Manager as a "full-stack consultant who helps partners grow their business" describes exactly the work I did at Birdeye — and the kind of ownership I've carried throughout my career. I'd bring 15+ years of B2B SaaS sales and channel partnerships to monday.com's North America team, and I'm in the Denver metro for the hybrid schedule.

At Birdeye I activated, onboarded, and managed a high-volume channel partner network, advising partners on retention, automated workflows, and how to communicate product value to their own customers — then tracked partner performance data to close adoption and revenue gaps. That partner work sits on top of years of quota-carrying, full-cycle SaaS sales: at Accelo I sold and negotiated complex CRM and project-management subscriptions to agencies and professional-services firms, building C-suite relationships and scoping solutions to each client's growth stage; at Fivestars I ran high-volume outbound prospecting and closing against quota. As founder of Solenzo, I take go-to-market and partner programs from A to Z and build the outbound lead-generation engines that fill pipeline — the self-starter, move-fast mentality your team is built around.

I'm energized by the chance to own a region, recruit and grow a partner book, and work cross-functionally with your sales and CS organizations to accelerate deals. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my blend of channel and direct-sales experience can drive partner-sourced revenue for monday.com. Thank you for your consideration.
